text:
maria_marketing: Morning — kicking off a mini case with SparrowBridge. Interview with CTO Anya is Tue 3/16 10am PT. Need: 1) a short quote (<=30 words) from Anya; 2) legal OK on quote + logo use; 3) confirm webinar snippet for 3/25. @emily_csm I'll need transcript + customer approval.

emily_csm: Got it. I'll send the transcript to Anya right after the call and collect the quote. We need ~48h for approvals. @maria_marketing can you drop draft quote options here?

maria_marketing: Dropping two quick options below — pick or edit before sending to Anya.
```
Option A: "Redwood Inference let us serve real-time features at scale — latency dropped and costs fell, enabling better user experiences."
Option B: "By moving inference to Redwood, we saw meaningful performance gains and material cost improvements during our pilot."
```

jack_product: Can we include a short benchmark snippet vs our previous infra? SparrowBridge ran ~10k req/day in prod; in the pilot we observed ~2.3x latency reduction and ~40% cost decrease. Need eng signoff before publishing raw #'s.

sam_sales: For inbound leads from the case, route demo-requests → @sam_sales, product-questions → SDR queue. Can we add a form field "Interested in Dedicated" so we can tag? Also capture company size.

natalie_legal: Legal note: we need a signed customer marketing release before any logo/quote usage. Also please don't publish raw customer metrics without explicit writeup in the release. Suggest quote language: "SparrowBridge uses Redwood Inference for production inference; performance improvements were observed during the pilot." That avoids absolute %s until signed.

emily_csm: Anya prefers we soften the cost callout — wants "significant cost savings" instead of exact percent. She's OK with the performance phrasing. I'll aim to get the signed release by 3/18.

calendar-bot: Created calendar event "SparrowBridge Case Interview" — Tue 3/16 10:00 AM PT. Invite sent to Anya, @emily_csm, @maria_marketing. Link: https://calendar.company/evt/1757509876

maria_marketing: Updated social + webinar blurb below. If legal + CSM OK, I'll queue post for 3/26 AM. :rocket:
```
Social: "How SparrowBridge sped up ML features and cut ops overhead with Redwood Inference — join our customer webinar 3/25 to hear their playbook."
Webinar blurb: "Hear from SparrowBridge's CTO and Redwood's product lead on how they improved latency and reduced inference costs in production. Register: https://events.redwood.ai/sparrowbridge"
```

natalie_legal: OK after rewording. Send final quote text + signed release and we'll give greenlight for logo/quote usage.

sam_sales: Received. I'll update the form to add the "Interested in Dedicated" checkbox and prep two email subject line A/Bs for the follow-up nurture.
